shard.name: Lavalink
shard.description: Standalone audio sending node based on Java and Kotlin, designed for streaming audio to Discord bot voice connections.
shard.author: freyacodes & Midnight Team
shard.startupDone: Lavalink is ready to accept connections
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Lavalink Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl jq

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${LAVALINK_VERSION}" ] || [ "${LAVALINK_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest Lavalink release..."
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/lavalink-devs/Lavalink/releases/latest | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name == "Lavalink.jar") | .browser_download_url')
else
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/lavalink-devs/Lavalink/releases/download/${LAVALINK_VERSION}/Lavalink.jar"
fi

echo "Downloading Lavalink from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -o Lavalink.jar -fSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ ! -f "application.yml" ]; then
    echo "Creating default application.yml..."
    curl -o application.yml -fSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lavalink-devs/Lavalink/master/LavalinkServer/application.yml.example"
fi

echo "Lavalink installation complete!"
